question.worked_solution:
Notice that all of the terms have a common factor of $2.$ Therefore, we can simplify the expression by factoring out $2,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}98{s}^{2}+84s+18 & = \\ 2(49{s}^{2}+42s+9)\end{aligned}
$$

Now, let's factor the expression inside parentheses using the square of a sum formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}49{s}^{2}+42s+9 & = \\ (7s)^{2}+42s+{3}^{2} & = \\ (7s)^{2}+2\cdot (7s\cdot 3)+{3}^{2} & = \\ (7s+3)^{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our original expression factors as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}2(49{s}^{2}+42s+9) & = \\ 2(7s+3)^{2}\end{aligned}
$$
